main_text.l: Bibliis regiis, non posse typis, mandari.
enit etiam pontificis decretum, ut in
Praefatione vulgatae editionis à Clem. VIII.
tus Graecus cum translatione Latina sub excommunicationis
poena à Sixto V. prout continetur in Editione 70. ab ipso
Pontifice Maximo exactissime à viris doct-
ta & corrupta nimis, degenerans ab illo
foedata, in quo conveniunt omnes: ipse
dare fecit, quos vidi in Complutensi

page.notes: The left edge carries stains and show-through, which are not transcribed. The catchword "exa-" is repeated at the start of the next page's text. The text has no marginal notes. Readings are clear throughout; no words are marked as doubtful.
